dependency_graph.assessment: The graph resolves ciso8601 to pypi 2.4.1 (requires_python >=3.8) with zero forward dependency edges (direct or transitive) and 23 reverse dependents on PyPI (e.g. homeassistant, hass-nabucasa, faust-streaming, datacube). The Debian riscv64 binary python3-ciso8601 2.3.3 depends only on libc6 and python3. This agrees with the checkout: no install_requires, no native library; build/test-only deps (setuptools, wheel/build, pytz) are not modelled by the graph, so they were audited separately on PyPI. An empty result here reflects the absence of declared runtime edges, not missing data, because the project resolved successfully.

proposal.architecture_precedent: Dedicated native runner rows: ubuntu-24.04-arm/aarch64 and windows-11-arm/ARM64 (not a shared ubuntu-latest QEMU arch list). A riscv64 row on ubuntu-24.04-riscv follows this existing native-per-architecture topology.
proposal.build_backend: setuptools with setup.py Extension (module.c, timezone.c, isocalendar.c); no [build-system] table; no third-party native libraries. Build/test deps setuptools, wheel, build, pytz are pure-Python universal wheels on public PyPI (checked: pytz-2026.6-py2.py3-none-any, setuptools-84.2.1-py3-none-any, wheel-0.48.0-py3-none-any, build-1.6.1-py3-none-any); the RISE index has no entry for them and none is needed, so PIP_EXTRA_INDEX_URL/PIP_PREFER_BINARY are not required for this project.
proposal.fork_guards: None: no github.repository conditions in any workflow.

path_coverage.assessment: Add matrix include os ubuntu-24.04-riscv, cibw_archs riscv64; make the legacy cibuildwheel v3.4.1 step conditional off for riscv64; add riscv64 to [tool.cibuildwheel.linux] archs for local-run consistency (CIBW_ARCHS env already overrides).

release.yml calls build-wheels.yml with upload: true and artifact names derive from matrix.os/cibw_archs, so the new row is uploaded automatically; PyPI upload is manual. No release file change needed.
setup.py and MANIFEST.in have no arch conditionals; classifiers say OS Independent. No package metadata change required.
Add an Unreleased entry for riscv64 wheels. README/CONTRIBUTING/RELEASING have no architecture matrix to update.
module.c, timezone.c, isocalendar.c are portable C with no architecture-specific code or assembly; no riscv64 change needed (CONTRIBUTING forbids hand-coded per-arch assembly).

risks: RISE runner GitHub App must be installed for the closeio org; otherwise the job stays queued
Legacy v3.4.1 step must be conditional (setup-python has no riscv64)
Runner python3 must provide venv/pip for the v4.3.5 action
PR #176 may touch pyproject.toml
cp38 and PyPy riscv64 wheels not produced

target_matrix.interpreters: CPython 3.9-3.15 via v4.3.5; cp38 and PyPy have no v4 riscv64 identifiers; legacy step skipped on this row
target_matrix.test: python -m unittest with pytz (pure-Python wheel from public PyPI)
